collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DISABILITY AND HUMAN DIVERSITY (DIV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Disabled villagers, chronic illness and every kind of body, skin, hair and face: wheelchairs with real wheels, crutches, canes, ear trumpets, signs and lenses made from island materials; good days and hard days; competence, humor and opinions. Sometimes the difference is the story. Often it's just part of the scenery.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder and a craftsperson or another adult; in the story (name1)'s sight has dimmed)

collection.description: An elder whose sight has dimmed cannot read the small marks on the storehouse baskets: carve them big, or use other baskets.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The storehouse baskets are marked with small carved symbols on their lids: one for taro, one for dried fish, one for seeds. (subject)'s eyes have dimmed with age, and (subject.he/she) can't make out the little marks anymore. (subject.He/she) has just opened three baskets looking for seeds and found fish three times. (friend) is carving new lids.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) asks for the marks to be bigger and deeper, so (subject.he/she) can feel them as well as see them. (friend) carves them as big as a hand, cut deep. (subject) runs (subject.his/her) fingers over the seed mark and smiles. A week later, everyone is using the big marks, because nobody, it turns out, enjoyed squinting at the small ones. Even the children can find things now.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (friend) suggests a simpler idea: different shapes. Round baskets for seeds, square for fish, tall for roots. (subject) likes it. It takes a while to reorganize the whole storehouse, and several people put things in the wrong baskets for weeks. But (subject) can find anything by touch now, in the dark if (subject.he/she) has to. (subject.He/she) demonstrates this, at night, to prove it.
